svg.text: PLAN — BED AND PARTITION
SCALE 1:50 · BOTH 8 FT · SET OUT FROM THE RIGHT WALL
TV — 4 FT ½ IN
BED 6 FT × 6 FT
BED WALL · FIRST FIGURE IS THE ENTRANCE DOOR, OPEN FLAT
AT THE PARTITION LINE
BED BACK — FROM THE FOOT OF THE BED
ELEVATION · 1:25 · THE CURLS SEEN END-ON
A · FROM THE DOOR
STANDING AT THE ENTRANCE, LOOKING IN
B · BED TO PARTITION
FROM THE BED, LOOKING AT THE TV
C · PARTITION TO BED
FROM THE PARTITION, LOOKING AT THE BED
D · FROM THE STUDY
THE PARTITION'S BACK, THE BED BEYOND
SETTING OUT
REVISION 3 · FEET AND INCHES
Both pieces moved 6 in to the right: 2 ft 11 in from the right wall to each.
Partition line: 4 ft 1½ in · partition 8 ft · 2 ft 11 in.
Bed wall: 3 ft 0 in open door · 1 ft 7 in clear · bed back 8 ft · 2 ft 11 in.
Bed: 5 ft 7 in · bed 6 ft 6 in · 3 ft 11 in. The bed back shows 1 ft 0 in each side.
OPEN — THE PARTITION AT 11 FT DOES NOT LEAVE ROOM FOR THE BED. Its curls
reach forward to 11 ft 11⅛ in from the study wall and the foot of the bed is at
12 ft 9 in: only 9⅞ in between them. For a 2 ft walkway the
partition wants to be about 8 ft 11 in from the study wall — or 11 ft measured
from the BED wall, which leaves 3 ft 1 in. Confirm which end it is from.
OPEN — the ledges inside the curls come to 9⅜ in wide × 1 ft 4½ in deep. That holds a phone
and a slim lamp, not a nightstand — 9 in a side is all 8 ft leaves.
ASSUMED — bed back 4 ft 6 tall, ledges 2 ft high. Bed and partition line measured.

g.text: 3 — bed 6 ft x 6 ft; partition line at 11 ft
